output:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
Ministry of Urban Development,
Government of India,
Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi – 110011.

Subject: Request under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 — Certified copy of the Annual Report of the Ministry of Urban Development for FY 2025-26.

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, Ada Lovelace, a citizen of India residing at 12 Civil Lines, wish to seek the following information under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005:

1. A certified copy of the Annual Report of the Ministry of Urban Development for the financial year 2025-26 (1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026).

2. If the Annual Report has been published on the Ministry's website, please inform me of the exact web address where it can be downloaded, in addition to providing the certified copy sought above.

3. If the Annual Report for FY 2025-26 is yet to be published, please state the current status of its preparation and the expected date of publication.

I enclose the prescribed application fee of Rs. 10/- by Indian Postal Order drawn in favour of the Accounts Officer, Ministry of Urban Development, payable at New Delhi.

I request that the information be supplied to my postal address given below within thirty days of receipt of this application, as prescribed under Section 7(1) of the Act. Should any part of the information be held by another public authority, I request that this application be transferred under Section 6(3) of the Act and that I be informed of such transfer.

If any clarification is required regarding this request, you may contact me at the address below.

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

(Ada Lovelace)
12 Civil Lines

Date:
Place:

Enclosure: Indian Postal Order of Rs. 10/- towards application fee.
